en.how.heading: What it is like to work with me
en.how.beliefSub: Most tools people use at work are joyless. They function and nobody looks forward to them. I do not think that is a law of nature. A thing can be correct, fast, accessible and still make someone smile when it loads.
en.how.s1b: Not the solution, and not a specification. The first conversation is about what is going wrong and who it is going wrong for. Free, and it costs you one email.
en.how.s2t: I find the smallest thing that would help
en.how.s2b: Usually smaller than expected. The point is a working thing you can react to in weeks, not a plan you approve and wait months for.
en.how.s3t: We look at it together and I change it
en.how.s3b: Short loops. You see it early enough that changing your mind is cheap, which is the only way anyone ends up with the right thing rather than the thing that was specified.
en.how.s4b: Tested, documented, and readable by the next person. I would rather hand something over well than be needed forever.

en.plot.lead: Research, teaching, a contest platform, and a poetry zine that raised money after two typhoons. Some of the most useful things I have built were unpaid.
en.write.hook: Would you like to grow something with me?

en.cyc.caption: Dependency matrix. Each button makes the row depend on the column.
en.cyc.note: Tarjan's algorithm, running here, not precomputed. A regex can see that auth mentions billing. Only a graph walk can see that billing comes back round to auth through two other modules.
en.dash.label: Paste any notes
en.dash.note: Laid out as you type, in under a millisecond. The manual version took thirty-six minutes. No model runs here: deciding that 1,240 is a measurement is a rule, not a guess.
en.tools.label: Do I know your stack?
en.tools.resting: tools I have shipped with. Search for yours, or open the list.
en.tools.no: Not on the list, which is not the same as never. The list is what I have shipped with, not everything I can pick up.

fil.how.belief: Dapat may halaga ang pagbukas ng software.
fil.how.beliefSub: Karamihan sa mga tool sa trabaho ay walang saya. Gumagana, pero walang naghihintay sa kanila. Hindi ito batas ng kalikasan. Puwedeng tama, mabilis, accessible, at nakangiti ka pa rin kapag nag-load.
fil.how.s1b: Hindi ang solusyon, hindi ang spec. Ang unang usapan ay tungkol sa kung ano ang mali at kanino ito nangyayari. Libre, at isang email lang ang gagastusin mo.
fil.how.s2t: Hahanapin ko ang pinakamaliit na makakatulong
fil.how.s2b: Kadalasan mas maliit kaysa inaasahan. Ang layunin ay isang gumaganang bagay na makikita mo sa loob ng ilang linggo, hindi planong hihintayin mo nang ilang buwan.
fil.how.s3t: Titingnan natin ito nang sabay at babaguhin ko
fil.how.s3b: Maikling ikot. Makikita mo agad kaya mura ang magbago ng isip, at iyon lang ang paraan para makuha ang tamang bagay, hindi ang bagay na nakasulat lang.
fil.how.s4b: May test, may dokumentasyon, at mababasa ng susunod na tao. Mas gusto kong maayos kong maiabot ito kaysa kailanganin ako habambuhay.
